theorems.name: Submission.p02_es_177ebb5a_crl_horizontal_difference_limit
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (a : ℝ) (H G : ℂ → ℂ), 0 < a → ContinuousOn G {z : ℂ | 0 < z.im} → (∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → HasDerivAt H (G z) z) → (∀ B : ℝ, 0 < B → ∃ C Y : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ 1 ≤ Y ∧ ∀ z : ℂ, |z.re| ≤ B → Y ≤ z.im → ‖G z‖ ≤ C * (1 + z.im) ^ n * Real.exp (-a * z.im)) → ∀ x : ℝ, Filter.Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => H ((x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) - H ((y : ℂ) * Complex.I)) Filter.atTop (nhds (0 : ℂ))
theorems.natural_summary: Bounds horizontal differences using the fundamental theorem of calculus, then applies polynomial–exponential decay and the squeeze theorem.
